svg.text: 23:41 · Curfew: violence high, security response limited · Block 7 · Unit 7-2216
Click the TV again to change channel · Esc, B or a click off it zooms back to the room
Clicking the TV just pushes the camera in until the
set fills the screen; the room is still there round
its edges. Far away it was a colored glow; here it
runs the full ad and Minerva’s ticker.
It stays on the room’s slant (true to the world).
